tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search active Port66 listings: luxury, streetwear and collectibles. Returns price, condition, authenticity level, image and link for each.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Everything about one listing: description, condition, provenance record and how to buy it.

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: Assets and chains a buyer can pay from. The seller always receives USDC.

tools.name: price_in_crypto
tools.description: Live, non-binding price of a listing in a crypto asset, from NEAR Intents solvers: what the buyer would send so the seller receives the exact USD price in USDC. Reserves nothing.

tools.name: start_purchase
tools.description: Reserve a listing for the signed-in buyer and get a one-time NEAR Intents deposit address and the exact amount to send. Nothing is charged by this call; the purchase completes when the buyer's wallet sends that amount. Needs a Port66 session.

tools.name: purchase_status
tools.description: Progress of a purchase: awaiting_deposit, deposit_seen, processing, paid (order recorded), refunded, failed, expired or review. Needs a Port66 session.

tools.name: report_deposit
tools.description: Tell Port66 the hash of the buyer's deposit transaction. Optional; it only speeds up detection.

tools.name: make_offer
tools.description: Offer the seller a price below the listed one, with a message. The seller has 24 hours to answer. If accepted, start_purchase charges the agreed amount. Needs a Port66 session.

tools.name: offer_status
tools.description: The buyer's latest offer on a listing, and the agreed price if the seller accepted. Needs a Port66 session.
